summary: xAI announced that Grok Bot, its autonomous AI agent product launched in beta on August 11, is now included with SuperGrok, Cursor Pro and Cursor Teams plans, with usage tracked separately from existing plan quotas.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement describes autonomous agents that run in parallel, work across apps without supervision, and are given entire jobs or functions rather than being operated step by step.
mechanisms.quote: They're digital teammates you can message, run in parallel, and trust to finish work in the tools you already use.

mechanisms.reason: Expanding Bot access to more plans, with always-on agents that keep working while a user steps away, broadens the base of continuous automated usage.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Bot is now included with all SuperGrok, Cursor Pro, and Cursor Teams plans.

practices.reason: Teams building on SuperGrok or Cursor plans now have a separate usage pool for Bot tasks that needs to be tracked apart from existing quotas.
practices.quote: Grok Bot comes with its own usage, separate from your Grok and Cursor plans, so anything you hand off to a Bot won't count against your existing usage.
